scope_and_isolation: Only M1 and B1 are implemented; dormant fallback code is absent.
The raw workbook is opened read-only and its SHA-256 remains frozen.
All generated code and results remain under the declared blind-test root.
Denied-body and network access counts remain zero.
input_and_domain_contract: B, J, K, P and V are mapped to woman, gestational week, BMI, GC and Y concentration with the declared units.
Primary and official-GC sensitivity masks are fixed before fitting and are identical for M1 and B1 within each domain.
No row-wise train/test or resampling split is used; every resample keeps a woman's rows together.
Included and excluded row and woman counts are saved.
method_and_inference: B1 and M1 design matrices match q1_code_plan.md, including the conditional primary-domain GC indicator only in M1.
CR1 woman-clustered covariance is computed without treating rows as independent.
At least 999 cluster-bootstrap resamples succeed per method/domain, or the run is explicitly non-successful.
Bootstrap intervals are primary uncertainty evidence; normal-approximate clustered p-values are labelled secondary.
R-squared and RMSE are labelled descriptive and no causal or clinical recommendation is claimed.
outputs_and_reproducibility: The planned script, two tables, metrics JSON and run_summary.json exist, are nonempty and mutually consistent.
run_summary.json records seed, environment, inputs, outputs, warnings, analysis-domain evidence, degeneracy and fallback state.
A controller rerun reproduces all deterministic formal output contents after excluding runtime timestamps and durations.
The five named Python review checks pass; any required failure blocks G3.

fallback_trigger_rule: F1_nonparametric_rescreen is observed but not implemented if rank, bootstrap completion, domain-direction, degeneracy or material-instability conditions in q1_code_plan.md fire.

verdicts.PASS_G3: All hard conditions pass and warnings do not change method legality.
verdicts.PASS_WITH_WARNINGS_G3: All hard conditions pass but limitations materially constrain interpretation and must enter the result card.
verdicts.FAIL_G3: Any required named check, identity, isolation, domain, clustering, bootstrap or output condition fails.

efficiency_rule: Run the implementation once and one controller reproducibility rerun only; do not repeat successful computations or create decorative artifacts.
